title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 path traversal was possible via JSON Schema references in untrusted projects…
description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3. This issue arises from JSON Schema references in untrusted projects, potentially allowing an attacker to access files outside the intended directories. The vulnerability has a low severity rating and requires user interaction to exploit.
